evidence_items.description: Sourcey publishes its open startup-credits registry at https://sourcey.com/startup-credits, a real external site reachable over HTTPS.
evidence_items.observed: Canonical human-facing page of the registry; HTTP 200 with registry content.

evidence_items.description: Sourcey publishes a machine-readable JSON release of the registry at https://sourcey.com/startup-credits.json.
evidence_items.observed: Valid JSON release with release_id sha256:f6182296…, listing 586 companies and 648 offers.

evidence_items.description: A public HTML page on an admitted host carries a visible anchor linking to the Sourcey registry.
evidence_items.observed: citation.html contains <a href="https://sourcey.com/startup-credits"> near the top of the page, plus a link to the .json release.

evidence_items.description: The citation page discloses its purpose and date of creation.
evidence_items.observed: Disclosure section dated 2026-11-06 states the page exists solely to publish a verifiable public citation.
